links.description: Located at frontend/src/assets/vite.svg, this is the default Vite scaffold logo typically imported by the app entry/header component or referenced as a favicon to indicate the frontend was bootstrapped with the Vite build tool.
Presence of the React logo asset alongside a 'frontend' directory structure suggests the frontend application is built using the React framework.

The image shows two isometric rounded-square 'card' or 'tile' shapes stacked vertically and connected by dashed guide lines: an upper outlined (unfilled/white) tile floats above a lower solid tile rendered with a purple-to-violet gradient and subtle radial highlight streaks. The minimalist, abstract geometric style (no text, no photography) and the exploded/layered composition suggest a decorative hero/banner graphic conveying concepts like stacking, layering, scheduling shifts, or modular structure - fitting for a landing page hero section of a scheduling/shift-management app ('Shifter Online').

Located under frontend/src/assets/, this logo asset is bundled as a static image resource for the Shifter Online frontend, typically shown on a template/landing page or as favicon/branding to indicate the app is built with React.

The SVG is a stylized abstract mark (a diagonally-cut, arrow/bolt-like polygon rendered in a purple gradient with layered, heavily blurred violet and cyan blob shapes masked inside it to create a soft glossy glow/gradient effect) placed at frontend/public/favicon.svg, which by standard web app convention serves as the browser-tab favicon / brand icon for the Shifter Online frontend application.
The SVG is the atom-shaped cyan (#00D8FF) React brand mark (iconify--logos class, viewBox 0 0 256 228), the standard visual identity for the React JavaScript library.

The SVG renders the standard two-tone (purple/blue) angular 'bolt' Vite logo, wrapped in bracket-like parenthesis strokes, with an embedded <title>Vite</title> and a dark-mode-aware style block for the parenthesis fill color.
